description: Save a bid search as the signed-in user's FindMyBids alert. New open bids that match it are emailed to the user and listed by get_my_bids. This saves to the user's account: call it only after the user confirms the keywords and states.

keywords.description: What the user's business does, comma-separated, e.g. "janitorial, floor care".
keywords.title: Keywords

states.description: Two-letter US state codes where the user wants work, e.g. ["TX"].
states.title: States

name: save_alert
title: Save my bid alert
